basis: Independent comparison of review/audit/audit.json with the candidate run, targeted/OCR evidence, and this video's evidence pack only.

discrepancies.finding: The candidate samples the whiteboard but never reconstructs the visible roughly 30-item curriculum plan; KU-17 instead states that no course table was observed.
discrepancies.impact: A screenshot sample without an executed visual reading does not close the channel, and a plan-versus-delivery boundary is lost.
discrepancies.requiredClosure: Add a bounded visual observation that the board supports planning only, mark most lesson text unreadable, and keep publication and learning outcomes unknown.

discrepancies.finding: The visible chat message that employers reject the sender because of hearing disability is omitted as a visual observation.
discrepancies.impact: The candidate preserves the author's narration and transaction uncertainty but leaves the visual support chain incomplete.
discrepancies.requiredClosure: Record the bounded chat text as an anonymized visual observation, then explicitly keep identity, disability verification, job result, transaction relation, and fee history unresolved.

discrepancies.finding: The candidate does not generalize free courses and electronic materials into free consulting, monthly service, enterprise-IP incubation, or Q&A-community service.
discrepancies.impact: The free-versus-paid scope boundary is correctly preserved.

discrepancies.finding: The candidate refuses to use chat or transaction screenshots as proof of account growth, completed employment, payment direction/purpose, or complete fee absence.
discrepancies.impact: No screenshot-to-growth/job/fee causal upgrade is counted.
